result.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can perform a broad range of tasks across diverse settings, yet their performance in agentic contexts remains poorly understood. Although online evaluations in simulators and real-world environments are essential for measuring interactive agent performance, they are costly and challenging to scale. Complementary offline VQA benchmarks can enable faster and more reliable comparisons across agentic domains, yet existing benchmarks remain limited and fragmented. To address this gap, we introduce AgentVQA, an offline benchmark for evaluating VLMs on realistic agentic scenarios across five agent domains: Web Agents, Robotics, Egocentric Videos, Games, and Spatial Planning. We build AgentVQA by manually selecting 1000 challenging, real-world agent examples from 23 source datasets and adapting them for reliable offline evaluation. The resulting benchmark preserves realistic scenarios from interactive environments across diverse domains, and its model rankings track those from corresponding online evaluations. Across the 22 evaluated models, the best achieves only 58.5% accuracy. Our cross-domain analysis shows that errors are driven primarily by failures to ground and maintain accurate representations of the current and evolving visual state, including localizing relevant UI elements, interpreting motion, tracking state changes over time, and inferring 3D spatial relationships, rather than by task misinterpretation or downstream logical reasoning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AgentVQA 离线基准，从 23 个源数据集人工挑选 1000 个跨 Web、机器人、自我中心视频、游戏与空间规划的 agent 场景样本，用于评测 VLM 的 agent 式视觉理解；22 个模型中最佳仅 58.5%。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨域错误分析将失败归因于视觉状态定位与随时间演化状态的维持（UI 元素、运动、状态变化、3D 关系），直接对应「内部状态是否保留任务必要视觉细节」这一主线，可供核查 latent 推理是否真能改善状态维持，而非只提升下游逻辑。
